messages:
maria (partnerships): Heads-up: pilot kickoff for marketplace + HW SI co-sell. We dropped a few handoffs last quarter. Want a lightweight rule set to reduce churn.

jake (sales): +1, need a clear SLA so deals don't stall.

sunil (solutions): Proposal: 24h claim window after intake ping. Exceptions: ARR >= 250k OR opp_stage in (Demo, POC) => AE auto-owns. Unclaimed after 24h -> partnerships queue.

olga (pm): Product needs: auto-set SFDC tags on claim and surface intake status. Also block external announce unless listing == PUBLISHED.

maria (partnerships): Minimal SFDC tags: `si_cosell_claimed_by`, `si_cosell_claim_ts`, `marketplace_state`.

sunil (solutions): Intake rule (pseudo):
```
IF si_interest=1 THEN
  IF ARR>=250000 OR stage IN ('Demo','POC') THEN set owner=AE
  ELSE notify claim_window_start
END
```
If no owner after 24h -> owner=partnerships_queue.

jake (sales): Contested accounts? Field vs SI conflicts happen too often.

sunil (solutions): Tie-breaker logic: 1) AE activity_count_last_30d > 2 => AE wins. 2) else earliest technical activity timestamp wins. 3) if tie -> partnerships-ops adjudicate within 24h.

maria (partnerships): We'll add Slack adjudication template: `@partnerships-ops adjudicate lead:<id> contested_by:<A>,<B>`

olga (pm): Intake card states proposed: NEW -> CLAIMED -> TECH_SYNC -> PM_SIGNOFF -> LEGAL_REVIEW -> MARKETPLACE_PENDING -> PUBLISHED. Show activities_last_30d and first_tech_activity_ts for visibility.

nina (legal): Legal needs 3 business days after PM signoff for co-branded announce review. Hardware partners with export flags add 2 business days for compliance. We can automate reminders but not skip review.

maria (partnerships): Metrics to track during trial: percent_claimed_within_24h, contested_rate, avg_time_to_publish, legal_block_rate.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: SI co-sell handoff check-in weekly Thursdays 10:00 PT.

maria (partnerships): Action items: 1) eng - SFDC auto-tags (sunil), 2) product - intake UI + metrics (olga), 3) legal - SLA automation (nina), 4) partnerships - ops playbook + Slack template (maria). Will circulate 1-pager by EOD tomorrow. Trial 24h claim window starts next Monday if no objections. :thumbsup:
